items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I stayed with him until I got this job by Black Wyatt, Douglas.

ctx.x: Yeah, Buddy Petit was dead then.

Yeah. Yeah. About 33 or 34, I started playing with Milton. We played together about three or four years. Oh. And that's, that run out. Music was absolutely nothing. You got around, when you getting down playing music, you got a man to change a dollar and play, and you know that was tough. Yeah. I remember once, I got a little job there for this lottery man there on Hawks, that jury man on Stephen All Street. He had a little dance at a, you know, had a band that come play there for his lottery. I think I charged…
Well, you didn't even save your heart then? No.
